verdict.rationale: Stagehand ships an official MCP server/integration ('Give a Claude Code agent persistent Stagehand browser tools over MCP/stdio', docs on MCP introduction and MCP best-practices), and independent community evidence corroborates this (the Stagehand MCP server won Anthropic's Claude MCP hackathon). Missing for 10: deeper hands-on user reports specifically testing the MCP server in production and more comprehensive first-party MCP setup docs beyond the overview pages.
